properties.label: Extended Property Filtering
properties.description:
Configure Microsoft Graph singleValueExtendedProperty used to filter calendar events (e.g. Matter ID).

Purpose:
• Filter Microsoft Calendar events using a custom business identifier.
• Commonly used to group or isolate events related to a specific Matter, Case, or Reference ID.

GUID & Name Guidelines:
• GUID must be a valid UUID in the format:
  xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx
• The GUID must be exactly the same as the one used while creating or updating events.
• Name must match the extended property name defined during event creation.
• GUID and Name together form a single extended property identifier.

Rules:
• Only one extended property is supported for filtering.
• Do NOT use separators such as ; or ,.
• Value comparison is performed as plain text.

Important:
• If either GUID or Name does not match exactly, filtering will return no results.

properties.label: Technical Configuration Notes
properties.description:
This datalist supports multiple filtering modes using Microsoft Graph calendarView API.

Built-in Time Filters:
• Supported values:
  – today
  – week
  – month
  – range

How to Configure:
• Drag and drop a filter column in the datalist.
• Configure it as a dropdown with the following values:
  today, week, month, range

Date Range Filtering:
• If range is selected:
  – Drag Start Date and End Date fields into the filter section.
  – Both dates must be provided for range filtering to work.
• Date format must be:
  yyyy-MM-dd

Extended Property Filtering:
• Events can also be filtered using the configured extended property.
• Filtering will work only if:
  – GUID is valid and correctly configured.
  – Property Name matches exactly with the event’s stored extended property.
  – The event was created or updated with this extended property.

System Behavior:
• Time-based filters are applied first.
• Extended property filter is applied on top of the time range.
• Incorrect configuration will result in an empty list without errors.
